_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Wanpela Player vs Dealer

📖 GAME OVERVIEW:
• Yu kamap long {start_chips} chips
• Wanpela deck long 52 cards (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Yu pley against dealer (haus)
• Kila raun i bihainim Ultimate Texas Hold'em struktur: yu post ANTE na BLIND bets, kisim 2 hole cards, deside long optional PLAY bets across betting phases, then reveal community cards na compare yu best 5-card hand against dealer’s. Yu goal i maximize yu winnings (wen yu gat better hand), wail minimizing yu losses (wen yu gat worse hand).
• Game i pinis wen yu rausim 0 chips o below long start long raun (LOSS) o complete 1000 raun long chips (WIN)

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Mandatory ${ante} bet kila raun
• BLIND: Mandatory ${ante} bet kila raun
• PLAY: Optional bet long gameplay. Throughout raun, yu ken chusim ONLY WAN long following: (${ante4} if done long PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} if done long FLOP, o ${ante} if done long RIVER. Ken i fold long river, givim ap long hand, na mekim no bet.)

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• Yu kisim 2 face-up cards (yu hole cards)
• Dealer kisim 2 face-down cards (hidden from yu)
• 5 community cards i deal face-down initially
• Community cards i reveal progressively long game phases

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer i mas gat at least wan PAIR (2 cards long same rank) long qualify, usim 2 cards long hand na 5 community cards.
• Dealer qualification i afektem betting outcomes, as bai i explainim later.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] (${ante4}) o [check]
  • [4x]: Place ${ante4} PLAY bet, reveal first 3 community cards
  • [check]: No additional bet, reveal first 3 community cards

📋 FLOP:
  • If 4x bet placed: Only [skip] available (auto-reveal last 2 community cards)
  • If no 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) o [check]
  • [2x]: Place ${ante2} PLAY bet, reveal last 2 community cards
  • [check]: No additional bet, reveal last 2 community cards

📋 RIVER:
  • If 4x o 2x bet placed: Only [skip] available (auto-proceed long showdown)
  • If no prior PLAY bet: [1x] (${ante}) o [fold]
  • [1x]: Place ${ante} PLAY bet, proceed long showdown
  • [fold]: Givim ap hand, lose ANTE na BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • All cards reveal na evaluate
  • Best 5-card hand from 7 cards (2 hole + 5 community)
  • Bets settle according long payout rules

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer i no qualify: PUSH (bet return)
  • Dealer i qualify & yu win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Dealer i qualify & yu lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet return)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Unaffected long dealer qualification
  • Yu win: Bet return na additional payout based long yu hand strength
  • Yu lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet return)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four long a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: No additional payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Unaffected long dealer qualification
  • Direct comparison: Yu best hand vs Dealer's best hand
  • Yu win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Yu lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet return)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best long Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 long same suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 consecutive cards long same suit
  3. Four long a Kind: 4 cards long same rank
  4. Full House: 3 long a kind + 2 long a kind
  5. Flush: 5 cards long same suit
  6. Straight: 5 consecutive cards
  7. Three long a Kind: 3 cards long same rank
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs long different ranks
  9. One Pair: 2 cards long same rank
  10. High Card: Highest card wins

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] o [play bet 4x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] o [play bet 2x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] o [play bet 1x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] o [c]: Check (no additional bet)
• [fold] o [f]: Fold (givim ap hand)
• [skip] o [s]: Skip long next phase (wen no action needed)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Strong starting hands (pairs, high cards) often justify 4x bets
• Consider dealer qualification - weak hands may push if dealer i no qualify
• BLIND bet ken i very profitable long strong hands (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Watch yu chip stack! If i go long 0 o below long start long raun, yu lose.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE na BLIND bets i mandatory kila raun
• PLAY bets i optional na strategic
• Make sure yu input correct action, na only wan action long wan taim.
